mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO decreases by more than 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month, coupled with a CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase of more than 0.5% in the same month, signals strong economic activity and potential inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when both PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL meet the trigger conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the same month, signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp & PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when both UNRATE and PAYEMS meet the trigger conditions (t-test p > 0.05).
